definitions.explanation: A young cat, typically under one year old.

examples.japanese: {仔猫|こねこ}が{毛糸|けいと}で{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: The kitten is playing with yarn.

examples.japanese: {道端|みちばた}で{迷|まよ}い{仔猫|こねこ}を{拾|ひろ}って{家|いえ}に{連|つ}れて{帰|かえ}った。
examples.english: I picked up a stray kitten on the roadside and brought it home.

notes:
Refers to a young cat. The kanji {仔|こ} specifically means "young animal," distinguishing this from {子猫|こねこ}, which uses the more general {子|こ} (child). Both spellings are common, but {子猫|こねこ} is seen more frequently in everyday writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {迷|まよ}い{仔猫|こねこ}: stray kitten
- {仔猫|こねこ}を{拾|ひろ}う: to pick up a kitten
- {仔猫|こねこ}を{育|そだ}てる: to raise a kitten
- {仔猫|こねこ}の{里親|さとおや}: adoptive family for a kitten

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {猫|ねこ}: cat (general term for cats of any age)
- {子犬|こいぬ}: puppy (the canine equivalent)
